# Palyazz - Pályázat Management Landing Page

## Project Overview
A modern, mobile-first single-page landing page for Palyazz, a pályázat (grant/tender) management company featuring glassmorphism design. Domain: palyazz.eu

## Tech Stack
- HTML5
- CSS3 (with backdrop-filter for frosted glass effects)
- Vanilla JavaScript

## Design Guidelines
- Mobile-first responsive approach
- Glassmorphism/Frosted glass aesthetic
- Clean, professional look with blur effects and transparency
- Smooth scroll navigation
- Modern color palette with accent colors

## File Structure
- `index.html` - Main HTML structure
- `css/styles.css` - All styling including glassmorphism effects
- `js/main.js` - JavaScript functionality

## Sections
1. Hero - Main call to action
2. Services - Key offerings
3. About - Company information
4. Contact - Contact form and info

## Development Notes
- Use `backdrop-filter: blur()` for frosted glass effects
- Ensure fallbacks for browsers without backdrop-filter support
- Test on mobile devices first
